# DSO Settings – ASE Practice Question (VIDEO)


#### Description


Technician A says that when using a lab scope, most signals can be captured using the 20/20 Rule – that is, by setting up the scope to capture a range of 0-20v on the vertical scale and setting the time base to 20ms per division. Technician B says that a DSO does not capture a signal in real time – rather, it samples the voltage input and then plots that data on the screen.


**Who is correct?**
A) Technician A
B) Technician B
C) Both Technician A and B
D) Neither Technician A or B
